verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents a "Manage dashboards as code" section and lets users read, download and hand-edit full dashboard JSON specs. Service accounts provide programmatic API access for CI/CD pipelines, which supports repeatable provisioning. Alerts-as-code is barely evidenced: the only mention is agent skills/MCP that can manage alerts, and nothing describes Terraform or a declarative provisioning workflow. Missing for 10: Terraform provider or declarative provisioning docs, alert definitions as JSON/API, a documented dashboard/alert API reference, independent hands-on corroboration.
